# ref_game.IMPL: clock = MC_knlCurrentTime = CLOCK_BASE_MS + virtual ms, advanced by tick_ms (default 50) per tick
# ref_game.IMPL: timers = MC_knlDefTimer/SetTimer only record the callback; the runner calls timerCB itself once per tick
# ref_game.IMPL: props = PHONEMODEL="HL4-REF" (not LG-LU9400, so the 9400 timer path is off); PHONENUMBER fixed; TIMEZONE="GMT+09:00" (format read at 0x26c28-0x26ca0: "GMT" sign hh ":" mm)
# ref_game.IMPL: fs = MC_fs* backed by an in-memory dict (save files); not persisted
# ref_game.IMPL: audio = MC_mda* no-ops (clip handles are fake integers)
# ref_game.IMPL: orientation = AND2011 defaults _menuOptions+4 = 1 (OptionInit 0xbd624) = 320x240 landscape game rotated onto the 240x400 frame (touch_setUiChange 0x35d50, nTouchRotate=1).  The port targets 240x320 portrait (approved parameter): the reference forces _menuOptions+4 = 0 right after OptionInit returns (portrait path 0x35e18, the legacy layout), so game area = 240x320 + 80 rows of virtual pad that are never part of a hash.
# ref_game.IMPL: logo_h = until TitleFrame_Initialize the stock game area is 240x400 (Logo/notice screens laid out for 400 rows); the reference pokes _lcdG+0x58 = 320 after startClet and re-runs Touch_Stand_Initialize + UM_SetMenuXY so the J2ME target (240x320 throughout) sees the same layout
# ref_game.IMPL: prims = MC_grpFillRect(f,x,y,w,h,pgc) fills w x h; MC_grpDrawRect(f,x,y,w,h,pgc) outlines the INCLUSIVE extent x..x+w, y..y+h (the game passes w-1,h-1 and pairs it with an inner fill of w-2, so the pair is consistent); MC_grpDrawLine = Bresenham, both ends inclusive; foreground pixel = pgc context index 1; clipping to the frame buffer only
# ref_game.IMPL: touch = only touch_drawVirtualPad is stubbed (it draws below the 240x320 game area).  The TOUCH sprite layer (TOUCH/CIF skins) draws dialog/menu backgrounds inside the game area and stays active; pointer input is simply never generated
# ref_game.IMPL: consent = Load_smsAgree is stubbed to "agreed" (_gameMenu[0x21]=1): the real answer path waits for the carrier server forever offline; the port stores the answer and continues
# ref_game.IMPL: frame = platform frame 240x400; hashes cover only the game area (_lcdG+0x54 x +0x58 of the offscreen buffer _lcdG+0x10)
# ref_game.IMPL: heap = MC_knlAlloc/Calloc zero-filled; MC_knlFree recycles same-size blocks (pointer values are not observable)
